title: Evaluation of the feasibility and accuracy of self-blood tests depending on age
summary: Recording and comparison of selected blood parameters in self-blood test vs. conventional laboratory determination and questionnaire survey

interventions.name:
1. questionnaire (web-based)
2. Instruction "HemoScreen"
3. peripheral venous access
4. First self-blood test using HemoScreen with immediate venous blood collection for conventional laboratory determination of blood parameters
5.  After 2 h second self-blood test by means of HemoScreen with imm

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- capacity for consent
- Sufficient knowledge of German to understand the instructions and questions
Exclusion criteria:
- Non-consenting persons
- Failure to meet an inclusion criterion
- Limitations that make it difficult to use the HemoScreen device independently
- People with a medical background
